name: John Deere Waterloo Works - Tractor Operations - Waterloo IA

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed flagship John Deere Waterloo Works Tractor Operations complex at 3500 E Donald St, Waterloo IA. Largest Deere assembly complex globally (7/8/9 Series tractors). Roster geometric-center coords (moved 2958m) landed on the building mass; locked center refined to 42.5210,-92.2695.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Inferred true with medium confidence. This is a Fortune-500 flagship assembly campus set far back from public roads behind long private internal drives; such plants are universally fenced and gate-controlled. Street View coverage stops at public rural roads (E Donald St / 41st St) and never reaches the actual truck gate, so the barrier arm could not be directly confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred true with medium confidence. A staffed guard post is standard for a plant of this scale running public riding-tours; not directly confirmed in imagery as SV cannot reach the internal gate.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal private drives from the SE road junction to the docks are very long (>1 km of approach) — easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Central yard between building wings holds 60-90+ trailers in organized rows in the z18 imagery; capacity 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated multi-row trailer storage lots visible between building wings (z18 view at 42.521,-92.2695).
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated 45 across multiple building faces from z18-z20 imagery; long building wings with trailers backed in on east and south faces. Approximate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus with 6+ distinct building masses plus an on-site tractor test loop (42.517,-92.266) and two retention ponds.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity on physically separate building faces (north/east wings vs south wing staging) suggests separate ship/receive clusters; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved aprons and multi-lane internal drives provide ample room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimate; internal drives are wide multi-lane but exact gate lane count not visible.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified in imagery; left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Complex is surrounded entirely by farmland on the rural east edge of Waterloo IA — Rural.
